data.name: Darpana
data.gender_notes: Darpana is used as a unisex name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: In Hindu mythology, Darpana is a name of the goddess Saraswati, the goddess of knowledge and learning. The name Darpana means 'mirror' in Sanskrit. Saraswati is often depicted holding a mirror in her four hands, symbolizing the reflective nature of wisdom and learning. A person named Darpana is believed to possess the quality of reflecting wisdom and knowledge, and is a deep thinker and a wise advisor.
data.etymology: Darpana belongs to the Sanskrit linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Mirror of the mind, Reflector.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Darpana total 1, giving a life-path number of 1. Number 1 is linked with Sun and with the qualities of leadership, independence and initiative.
